name: Global Equities Dual Momentum Rotation (ETF)
stop_loss_rule: Absolute momentum cash-bond switch plus hard portfolio drawdown stop
rule_description: Compare 12-month trailing return of US equities (SPY) vs international equities (EFA) against short-term Treasury bills; hold the stronger equity ETF only when excess return is positive, otherwise rotate to aggregate bonds (AGG) with a hard defensive stop, zero grid, zero martingale.
raw_text: Public rule specification (Gary Antonacci Dual Momentum). Liquid spot ETFs SPY, EFA, AGG on W1/monthly cadence with zero CFD swap exposure. Combines relative strength and absolute trend filter; uses hard stop and defensive bond rotation. Non-grid, non-martingale, no leverage multiplier.
